title: PlaneMem complete workbench handoff registry
description: Complete handoffs operation model for POST /v1/workbench/query: current durable handoffs and historical projections, summary availability, query-bound pagination and reader-specific hints. Register session-activity-read.json alongside this resource.
$comment: Closed schemas describe reconstructed wire outputs. Runtime additionally checks UTF-16/lone surrogates, real dates, UTF8 bytes, exact scope/trace, target/claimant and reader equality, unique ordered rows, filters and canonical cursor binding. Generic JS parsers do not use a finite ordinary-JSON snapshot. No validator/generator/runtime evidence claimed.

time.description: Exact UTC six-digit microseconds with real-calendar millisecond-prefix roundtrip. No created<=updated rule in this directory parser; dedicated detail has different date/chronology rules.

queryText.description: Raw<=500 UTF-16 units; no controls/DEL/lone surrogate. Trim and omit when blank.

query.description: Raw fields without operation. Empty status/origin omitted; session_id/cursor cannot be empty and null rejected. Cursor fully parsed and canonically re-encoded. Default limit25 used at read time without inserting a field. No dedicated8KiB ordinary-JSON query snapshot.

normalizedQuery.description: Effective captured query, not echoed in the envelope. status=open groups saved open/offered; closed groups claimed/expired/accepted/rejected without rewriting saved status.

summary.description: Available summary is complete UTF8<=8KiB, no NUL/lone surrogate. Empty string/newlines/other controls retained; maxLength alone is not the byte rule.

recordFields.description: Fourteen complete base fields. Current session origin has positive safe numeric version; target, if present with claimant, must equal claimant. Old claimed records may lack actor. Expired may retain or lack ownership. Projection retains explicit nulls and nullable offered_to, without inferring current ownership/version. No saved trace, sources or full checkpoint notes in a row.

record.description: Normalized base record. Shared record parser also accepts recipient_matches/claimed_here input fields then strips them; envelope parser separately validates these hints.

readerRecord.description: Sixteen fields. Runtime recomputes recipient_matches from present identity, session origin and null-or-equal offered_to; claimed_here needs both client and actor equality. Flags do not require open/claimed status, so an expired row can retain matching ownership. They do not authorize claim/resume or prove an original request succeeded.

pageFields.description: Runtime data.length<=effective limit, unique handoff IDs, strict updated_at DESC/ID ASC after incoming cursor. Exact session/origin/grouped status checked; text search not recomputed. Continued page full, cursor at last row, changed from input and input binding retained. No total or cross-page snapshot.

page.description: Normalized base page without reader hints. Shared parser counts the complete supplied object's serialized bytes, including extra input fields it later strips.

scope.description: Nonblank<=1024 UTF-16/no controls/DEL/lone surrogate, exact current scope; no independent ULID check in registry parser.

envelope.description: Exact trace/scope/fixed three ordered sources. Identity scope matches current scope; returned actor/client are not independently compared to SDK original context by this registry parser. Two write_sessions hints equal, write implies claim, any write/claim needs identity. Whole candidate JSON.stringify/UTF8<=2MiB after metadata reads; no finite ordinary-JSON/depth/node snapshot. No query echo, ETag or outer revision.

cursorContent.description: Canonical compact ASCII JSON unpadded base64url [1,key,updated_at,handoff_id]. SHA256 key hashes handoff-registry-v1/scope/restricted/query/status/origin/session_id/limit, not trace/actor/client. Changing page size or effective filters requires restart; cursor is not signed or an authorization credential.

x-runtime-boundaries.http: Authenticated generic workbench POST with context.read Policy/audit, optional expected actor/client header checks and no verified-client requirement for reading. Pre-auth1MiB JSON, traceparent before x-trace-id, generic actor/path limiter. No dedicated URL-query/media/encoding/cache-condition rejection or write preconditions; generic success cache bypassed. No dedicated two-slot handler or whole database deadline.
x-runtime-boundaries.database: Single query unions current scoped handoff joined to same-scope checkpoint/session and historical projection filtered by readable undeleted parent. Same-scope durable ID always shadows projection, even when its checkpoint/session join fails or origin=projection requested. Historical projection does not join current session/checkpoint; references are not proof those targets remain readable. Apply all filters/position before MATERIALIZED LIMIT+1, order updated_at DESC/handoff_id COLLATE C. Parse only first limit rows; lookahead is existence. Hidden/missing parent yields empty200.
x-runtime-boundaries.summary: Current summary is first nonnull of next_actions[0],in_progress[0],completed[0], preserving empty strings; projection uses saved summary. SQL masks output over8KiB UTF8 as null/too-large, SQL null is missing. Literal lower/strpos search covers handoff/session/checkpoint IDs, offered_to, claimed_by, claimed_by_actor and unmasked summary, not from_client. Search may match omitted text. No full notes, source validation, automatic expiry or current ownership inference for projection.
x-runtime-boundaries.metadata: Identity present iff authenticated_client===true. write_sessions needs verified client plus admin/session.write; claim also allows verified handoff.claim. Current caller flags are recomputed independently of status or write hints; legacy missing claimed actor never guessed. Version uses canonical positive decimal DB text converted to safe integer. Real microseconds retained; no created/updated chronology check.2MiB post-materialization JSON size does not bound SQL scans/sorts/prior allocations or cross-page consistency.
x-runtime-boundaries.sdk: listHandoffs normalizes query and shallow-copies context before default30s local request budget, no own-data/8KiB query snapshot. Complete custom-transport envelope parse and post-parse deadline check; no generalized finite-JSON/depth/node/getter/prototype guard. Fetch bounded-json separately includes credential/network/body, success2MiB/error16KiB, exact200/trace/media/fatalUTF8/content-length. No automatic retry/page/save; local cancellation does not prove SQL cancellation.
x-runtime-boundaries.errors: INVALID_INPUT400 false; HANDOFF_REGISTRY_INVALID500 false for bad/oversize page or hints; generic auth/policy401/403, RATE_LIMITED429 true, WORKBENCH_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE/WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE/AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE503 true and unexpected INTERNAL_ERROR500 true. SDK sanitizes only known same-trace codes to retryable=false; WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE absent from registry whitelist becomes GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE.
x-runtime-boundaries.remaining: Full HTTP composition pending other workbench models. SDK/CLI/MCP/Web hand-written parsers remain; no machine-schema consumption, Mock migration, query-plan/index execution or runtime proof. MCP session handoff resource uses an unpersonalized base page with continuation metadata; it is not this full workbench envelope.
